subject: Who won the fight between Kashimo and Sukuna?

beats.title: Plot Details
beats.text: Sukuna engages Kashimo in hand-to-hand combat and pushes him back. Kashimo tries to respond with a blast of electricity but Sukuna counters with a Dismantle that bisects the world. Sukuna warns Kashimo before sending the slash, so the latter only loses part of his hand. Kashimo recognizes this is the same attack that killed Satoru Gojo and there is a momentary pause in the action.

beats.title: Synopsis / Shinjuku Showdown Arc
beats.text: On December 24, the day of the fight, Yuji along with the other sorcerers see Gojo off while he prepares to fight Sukuna.(Chapter 212) Yuji along with his fellow sorcerers watched the fight between Gojo and Sukuna via broadcast while inside of Rika(Chapter 269) and was distraught after seeing him killed by Sukuna.(Chapter 236) Higuruma and Yuji drop down to fight Sukuna after Kashimo loses against him. While Higuruma is dispatched by Sukuna, Yuji keeps up the fight utilizing his Reverse Cursed Technique to heal his injuries.

beats.title: Plot Details
beats.text: Sukuna uses Kamutoke to summon a bolt of lightning as a diversion and flanks Kashimo. He uses his extra arms to immobilize Kashimo's hands and then pummels him with rapid-fire punches before throwing him aside. Kashimo tries to counterattack while he's sent flying, but a massive net of Dismantle slashes is already coming at him, spelling the end.

beats.title: Summary
beats.text: The God of Lightning, Hajime Kashimo, leaps into battle to take on Sukuna next. Kashimo not only seeks to defeat Sukuna, but to learn what it truly means to be the strongest.

beats.title: Synopsis / Tokyo No. 2 Colony: Incredible Luck / Jackpot! Luck VS Lightning
beats.breadcrumb: Synopsis / Tokyo No. 2 Colony: Incredible Luck / Jackpot! Luck VS Lightning
beats.text: Kashimo returns to the surface, drained of all his cursed energy, but he believes he's won. However, Hakari resurfaces as well and lands the final blow of their fight. He's missing his left arm but Hakari is alive and is the victor. He survived using a binding vow that sacrificed the arm Kashimo grabbed onto to protect the rest of his body. Hakari cuts a deal with Kashimo to work with him in exchange for fighting Sukuna. Afterward, Hakari visits Charles again and encourages him to continue drawing manga. Momo Nishimiya finds Hakari with Charles and informs him of their group's new plans for the Culling Game.(Chapter 190)

beats.title: Synopsis / Culling Game Arc
beats.text: During the Culling Games, Panda went to look for the Angel but found Kashimo instead who forced him to engage in a fight Panda activated Gorilla Mode but was overwhelmed by the sorcerer even with using his Unblockable Drumming Beat move. Panda now forced in a corner activated Triceratops Mode using his sister's core but it was destroyed in one move by Kashimo.(Chapter 184) Panda now just a head, was interrogated by Kashimo on where Sukuna's whereabouts were with Panda refusing to tell him as it would mean danger for Yuji, Hakari then appeared in time to fight off Kashimo, eventually after Kashimo's defeat Hakari reached a deal with him, that Kashimo would transfer his points in exchange for the sorcerers allowing him to fight Sukuna. Panda managed to survive his injuries by reverting to a chibi-esque form and is told of the deal, Panda however did not want be around Kashimo but still ultimately accepted.(Chapter 190)

beats.title: Synopsis / Shinjuku Showdown Arc
beats.text: Sukuna commends Gojo for his performance. He calls Gojo magnificent and swears to always remember him. The next to challenge Sukuna was Hajime Kashimo. Sukuna is elated after enjoying the battle with Gojo and tells Kashimo he has no right to spoil the moment.(Chapter 236) Above Kashimo, Uraume descended from the sky atop a massive block of ice. The ice continued to fall and Sukuna breaks the ice apart to retrieve the cursed tool Kamutoke from inside it, revealing it was one of his cursed tools from the Heian Era and Yorozu created a replica of it using her construction technique and a binding vow.(Chapter 237)
